caveats: The operation taxonomy is a proxy: Pulse records tool outputs, not full model context composition.
A zero class fraction means no matching operation occurred; it does not prove zero global spend.
Fits assume independent observations and are descriptive, not causal or workload forecasts.
Small distinct-operation and Hill-tail samples can produce wide or unstable intervals.

methodology.amdahl: Each class fraction is p for an optimization confined to that class.

classification.content: read, find, grep, glob, tree, and code-map operations
classification.history: expand, recall, history, and memory operations
classification.plan: shell, run, exec, plan, and batch operations
classification.prose: compact, rewrite, summarize, ingest, and prose operations

methodology.confidence_intervals: Asymptotic 95% intervals: normal OLS slope and log-scale Hill; not bootstrap intervals.
methodology.hill_tail_size: floor(sqrt(distinct items)), with a minimum of two
methodology.refs: All tz://, fz://, and gz:// strings in event metadata; values are not emitted.

hill.method: Hill tail index converted with s=1/alpha
Hill tail index converted with s=1/alpha
